name: 3D Gaussian Splatting for Surface Reconstruction
aliases: 3DGSR: Implicit Surface Reconstruction with 3D Gaussian Splatting
Implicit Surface Reconstruction with 3D Gaussian Splatting
definition: An implicit surface reconstruction method that incorporates an implicit signed distance field (SDF) within 3D Gaussians for surface modeling, enabling alignment and joint optimization of both SDF and 3D Gaussians.
summary: 3DGSR integrates a Signed Distance Field into 3D Gaussian Splatting for end-to-end surface reconstruction, eliminating post-processing while maintaining high-fidelity geometry and rendering efficiency.
